scenario.label: Can the library work on moving day?
scenario.text: On the fictional existing layout, the door clears the chair and bookcase. Treat the chair and lamp as a layout example. Ask which items would actually stay with the property.
scenario.basis: Existing library assessment LIB-01. Contents are unconfirmed.

cost_basis.label: Optional shelves
cost_basis.text: The shopping subtotal covers two oak shelves and a retained chair. Delivery, fitting, making good and contingency have no allowance. Obtain a written price before budgeting for the work.
cost_basis.basis: Fictional November 2026 schedule. No contractor quotation or whole-house estimate.

cost_basis.label: Purchase and moving costs
cost_basis.text: The buyer has supplied no acquisition figures or allowance for fees or temporary accommodation. Whole-purchase cash requirements remain open.
cost_basis.basis: Scope of this fictional viewing exercise.

occupation.label: Moving in
occupation.text: The existing layout can be used independently of the shelf decision if the room and furniture match the viewing. An installation date and access arrangements remain open.
occupation.basis: CAD-only room assessment. Occupation elsewhere in the house is outside this example.

viewing.label: During the viewing
viewing.text: Open the hall door fully. Stand at the bookcase while another person sits at the window. Locate the socket and ask which shelves and loose furniture are included.
viewing.basis: Door, bookcase and chair positions shown on sheet L-01.

follow_up.label: Before committing to works
follow_up.text: Ask the surveyor to identify the wall construction and any signs of damp at the bookcase. Ask the conveyancer to confirm the fixtures and contents from the seller's paperwork.
follow_up.basis: Unverified fabric, service location and sale inclusions. Record both replies before ordering.
